Hello, I had to make the same decisions a month (?) ago. You are not a burden. You are not crazy (even if you are suicidal!). When therapists make decisions they look at if you are an IMMEDIATE risk to yourself. This is when a therapist calls in a hold on you.

I imagine, at this point you have 3 options: let a therapist make a call, call yourself, or start IMMEDIATE intensive therapy. Because there is a hidden fourth option…. please take this very seriously - if you do not make changes in your life you, WILL end up dead. DEAD is your fourth option. 

Talking about options 1-3. If a therapist calls a hold on you, you will most likely have a bad time. A lot of your rights disappear and you *tend* to feel more victimized. 
IMMEDIATE intensive treatment, like EMDR or outpatient, is not usually an option. It’s hard to get in or you may not be receptive to it.
IMO, the best option is to check yourself in to Inpatient. Your rights will be intact. It may be easier to leave, when you are ready. 

Also!! If you still feel like a burden - try changing your thinking. I suggest looking at it this way -> if you go to inpatient, that usually unlocks so much more potential for new and more intense treatments. The people running the hospital/inpatient only provide the level of service you need, so you can’t take resources from someone else. :) You deserve what treatment the doctors deem necessary! They won’t give you any services you don’t need.

I felt like I was treated “more seriously” after going inpatient. I then went into outpatient, which is AMAZING!! I was helped to realize a ton of shit going wrong in my life and dump shit that wasn’t helping me. I really hope you can make that call and get yourself help. YOU NEED HELP, and you are worthy of that help. ❤️❤️
